title: Positive Čech cohomology of direct images of injective module sheaves vanishes
statement: Let h:X→S be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], and let I be an injective O_X-module [def-sp-injective-resolutions, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every open U of S, every family V_j of opens with arrows V_j→U and union U [def-sc-zariski-site], every choice C of the iterated fibre products and index maps [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex], and every p>0, the p-th Čech cohomology of C with coefficients in the underlying additive presheaf of h_*I [def-pc-module-pullback] is zero. The index type may lie in any universe max u w.

proof.text: Pull back the covering to h⁻¹U. Inverse image preserves unions and finite intersections. On the poset of opens, the universal properties of the products C.W p t identify them with the relevant intersections, so their inverse images are the products of the inverse-image family.

Direct image sections on W are I(h⁻¹W), with scalar restriction leaving the additive groups unchanged. The restrictions agree; hence the products of sections and alternating sums identify both additive Čech complexes, including every differential.

Apply module_injective_open_cover_cech_acyclic to the inverse-image covering on X. Transport IsZero across the cohomology isomorphism. Uniqueness of products makes the argument independent of the chosen C.

mathlib_searches.query: The direct image of an injective sheaf of modules is Cech acyclic for every open covering

lean.statement:
theorem module_pushforward_injective_cech_vanishing {X S : Scheme.{u}} (h : X ⟶ S)
    (I : X.Modules) [Injective I] :
    ∀ (U : S.Opens) (J : Type (max u w)) (V : J → S.Opens)
      (hom : ∀ j, V j ⟶ U), (⨆ j, V j) = U →
      ∀ (C : SiteCechComplex V hom) (p : ℕ), 0 < p →
        IsZero ((C.cohomologyFunctor p).obj
          ((toPresheaf S).obj ((pushforward h).obj I)))
